Observed:
- Nocturia two to three times per night
- Slow urinary stream
- Microscopic hematuria
- Circumferential urethral mass
- Amyloid protein deposition on biopsy
- 53-year-old man
- 3-year history of lower urinary tract symptoms
- No history of lichen sclerosis
- No history of sexually transmitted infection
- No history of pelvic radiation
- No history of genitourinary trauma
- No family history of genitourinary malignancy
- Normal renal ultrasonography findings
- Flexible cystourethroscopy revealed a circumferential urethral mass
- Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma
- Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition
- No additional disease manifestations of amyloidosis found
- Retrograde urethrography showed a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra
Differential diagnosis:
1. Localized amyloidosis of the urethra
2. Primary amyloidosis
3. Amyloid-associated urethral stenosis
4. Urethral amyloidosis with underlying monoclonal gammopathy
5. Secondary amyloidosis
